title: God of War Ragnarök (`GoWR.exe`, PC / Epic or standalone install)
notes: Workaround that worked for me on retail Highball 0.10.22:** The default Sikarugir Wine 10 engine from first-run setup was not enough for Ragnarök (D3D12). Installing the public CrossOver 26.3 engine from the Highball repo and pointing the bottle at it fixed the crash: Manifests and binaries are open source (`spike/engines/*.json`, [highball-engine](https://github.com/gauthierpiarrette/highball-engine) releases). Same stack family as CrossOver 26.3 D3DMetal, which already ran this title on my Mac. Enable **Advertise AVX** in Settings → Environments before first launch. Suggest: surface `x64-crossover26.3-*` in the app’s engine picker for D3D12 titles like Ragnarök, or document this path — it is not offered on “Get started” today. Log reference (failed run on Sikarugir r28): `CheckFeatureSupport` then `Application Crashed here (0xc06d007e)` in `~/Library/Application Support/Highball/logs/`.
session: Played through Highball after manual engine install (user-confirmed game running).
issues: Does **not** launch on the default shipped engine (`x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28`, Wine 10 Sikarugir) with D3DMetal: crashes after ~2 min black screen with D3DMetal `CheckFeatureSupport` unhandled queries (`0xc06d007e`). Works after switching to the CrossOver 26.3 engine build.
